title: ProblemDetails
description: PLURNK operation failure using RFC 9457 Problem Details. Extension members are permitted so an owning boundary can add structured recovery facts without inventing a second error envelope.

type.description: Absolute URI identifying the stable problem class.

title.description: Short, stable summary for this problem type.

status.description: Operation status. It must equal the containing result status.

detail.description: Specific, actionable explanation of this occurrence.

instance.description: Absolute URI identifying the failed durable operation, normally its log URI. Core adds it at persistence when a plugin cannot know the durable coordinate.
